The Kelp drift net item is a material.

Variations

This item can be obtained in the following variations. The 'fine' quality material can replace a normal drop with a base rate of 1/100. This can be increased by using items with the fine material finding attribute.

Variations

Requirement

  • At least Hunting lvl. 30.

Attributes (Input)

This item provides these attributes when used as an input for some activities. Fine materials used also benifit from a global bonus when used as inputs.

Quality Attributes

None

Global +40% Work efficiency
Global +200% Fine material finding
Global +10% Double rewards
Global +100% Bonus experience

Uses

Activity Input

Kelp drift net is used as a required input for the following activity:

Activity Name Location Requirement Note
Drift net hunting Kelp Forest in Syrenthia Needs 1x Hunting net This activity gains extra benefits from using fine material inputs.

Sources

Shop Purchases

Shop Name Location Region Item Type Stock Price
Undercurrent Vastalume Syrenthia 100 3

Primary Recipe Output

Craft a kelp drift net

With patient hands, you weave the kelp into a strong and flexible net. Each knot secures the promise of a bountiful catch, as you envision the vibrant marine life that will soon fill its meshes.

Weave a sturdy net from the resilient kelp, perfect for catching the ocean's bounty.
